name: OpenID Connect
overview: Sign in to Shoko through an OpenID Connect provider such as Authelia, with each subject mapped by hand to a Shoko user.

releases.release_notes:
First release. Sign in to Shoko through an OpenID Connect provider such as Authelia, with each provider subject mapped by hand to a Shoko user. Devices that cannot open a browser, such as TV apps, can be paired with a code.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.97` or newer.
